announcement.title: 🌸 Visual Novel Maker v1.5.0
announcement.content:
v1.5.0 adds scene interactions and new controls for live dialogue and character presentation.

  • Drag items, Item Piles, or journal pages onto the background to create clickable markers. Hide and reveal them, or chain actions.
  • Change character images using multiple resources, with separate rules for each expression.
  • Apply reusable dialogue styles to selected chat text. Includes eight built-in styles, automatic glossary links, and per-character fonts and colors.
  • Save title cards for Stories and macros. Switch backgrounds by in-game time and choose how image margins are filled.
  • Use expression shortcuts and custom emotion effects, select speakers from standings, bring in a saved party, and add staged characters to combat.
  • Item acquisition cards now handle empty descriptions, consecutive cards, and reconnecting players correctly. Overlay appearance changes reach players without reloading.

Requires GlitchSmith Library 0.13.1 or later. Item Piles and Unboxing the Mystery are optional; journal page marker actions require Unboxing the Mystery 1.5.0 or later.
